statement.zh: Randall-MacIver 与 Mace 以 EEF 特别出版物《El Amrah and Abydos, 1899–1901》(1902) 报告埃尔阿姆拉等地前王朝/古风墓地发掘。
statement.en: Randall-MacIver and Mace published Predynastic/archaic cemetery excavations at El Amrah (and related Abydos-area work) in the EEF special publication El Amrah and Abydos, 1899–1901 (1902).

editorial.notes: Density pass D-2026-10-11-22; fact claims cite registered sources only.
